name: Ağabey

stand_in.note: K89 yer tutucusu: Baba'nın modeli ×0,95 ve soğuk, koyu renk çarpanıyla (StandIn, scripts/character/stand_in.gd). Ateş başında CampNpcs/OlderBrother düğümündedir; Meshy modeli (meshy-final) assets/characters/older_brother/older_brother.glb olarak gelince yer tutucu kendiliğinden kalkar.

story: story.md §8.3: Çocuğun ağabeyi, Tanhu'nun atlısı; Godot'daki eski mete kaydının yerine (K37). Önsöz, Ev, II.
description: A young Hun horseman of about twenty, lively and quick, a dark top-knot with two long braids, a brown leather coat with a fur shoulder collar and studded shoulder pads over a cream tunic with red Greek-key borders, a wide belt with bronze animal plaques and a red sash, leather bracers, dark baggy trousers and tall brown boots. The bow and quiver are not on the mesh: the bow is a separate prop (bow).
